chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn [al-Ḥusayn ibn] Mūsā ibn Bābawayh al-Qummī, the author of this book, says:

The noble, eminent Sayyid Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-ʿAlawī al-Mūsawī al-Madanī, known as Niʿmah—may Allah continue his support, success, and right guidance—heard this book from its beginning to its end through my recitation to him, and I narrated it from my aforementioned shaykhs; and that was in the land of Balkh, in the district of Īlāq,
and I wrote it in my own hand, praising Allah and giving thanks, and sending salat and peace upon Muḥammad and his family. Āmīn, O Lord of the worlds.

key_terms.كَتَبْتُ بِخَطِّي: I wrote it in my own hand
key_terms.مِنْ نَاحِيَةِ إِيلَاقٍ: in the district or region of Īlāq

ai.seo_question: What does this ijazah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh say about the book’s transmission?
ai.summary: This passage is an ijazah-style certification by Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Bābawayh al-Qummī, confirming that Sayyid Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Madanī heard the entire book through the author's recitation. It also records the place of transmission and notes that the author personally wrote this statement while praising Allah and invoking salat upon Muḥammad and his family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh Al-Qummi, the author of this book, says:

The noble, virtuous Sayyid Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Alawi Al-Mousawi Al-Madani, known as Ni'mah - may Allah (swt) continue to support, grant success, and guide him - has heard this book from beginning to end as I recited it to him, and I have narrated it from my mentioned teachers.
This took place in the land of Balkh, in the region of Ilagh.
I have written this with my own hand, praising Allah (swt) and expressing gratitude, and sending prayers and peace upon Muhammad and his family. Ameen, O' Lord (azj) of the worlds.
